corrections.text: Independent review of WORK-example / PHASE-c7e84e75aba2f877d2a23196, obligation public-example-traceability: all three admitted pinned files were read completely (S1.tex 2 lines, public-illustration-inputs-v1.json 131 lines, public_representation_illustrations.py 103 lines); no reviewed bytes changed. The manuscript sum is correct. Direct arithmetic checks of the JSON reproduce zero generator column sums, YG=-4Y+2Z, ZG=2Y-12Z and initial region-mass derivatives -1,-3. Wrapper statically pins its delegated executable and parameter JSON, calls runpy once, deep-copies checks/parameters/artifacts, checks file hashes and labels the result metadata-only, not scientific acceptance. Finding REVIEW-PUBLIC-CLOSURE: the admitted three-file set does not include the delegated executable calculations/representation_illustrations.py (pin 6fbec2ba4f746abc5e5038455b450e0ef1ca546a64803a6827ac45b3cbcde670), raw/derived run results, generated outputs or source-bound proposal/application record. The handoff lists further evidence but it is outside this request's exact-input admission. Thus unchanged calculation, actual byte retention, rendered figures and the proposal-to-source transition cannot be independently established here; this is an evidence-admission gap, not evidence those artifacts are absent or wrong. Repair: offer a fresh, expressly admitted exact-pin review package including that executable, raw and derived results, complete output manifest/files and relevant proposal/application record, then obtain a scoped review of those bytes. Do not rerun or relabel historical outputs merely to fill this gap.

Independent review of WORK-example / public-example-traceability, handoff PHASE-c5e9156c5b41008cff816ce5. Non-blocking presentation repair, not a traceability failure: shared-register-price.pdf/.png panel B contains a grey dashed line at theta=1.0852782044993055 with no label. The supplied executable and public-illustration-inputs-v1.json identify it as the attention-suppression boundary acos(1-eta/(0.5+gamma)). Add that label to the figure legend or its accompanying explanation, distinguishing it from the green separation threshold 0.8410686705679301. Preserve the current pinned outputs as historical evidence; any changed output needs new pins and review.
